## Quality Checklist

- [ ] **Tests Passing**: Verified with `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e`.
- [ ] **Zero Dependencies**: Pure Node.js ESM built-ins only (no unapproved npm packages).
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: Commit message conforms to `type(scope): description` (lowercase, no trailing period, max 72 chars).
- [ ] **Co-Author Attribution**: Added appropriate `--trailer` if authored with AI assistance.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated `docs/` or `README.md` if behavior or configuration changed.
- [ ] **TUI Build**: If TUI code was changed, rebuilt cleanly with `npm run build:tui`.
